correctness.rationale: Rank-one nilpotent parametrization gives the exact character transform. A unique eigenspace of dimension \(n-c>n/2\) determines a scalar-class representative with kernel \(W\), counted exactly by a Gaussian binomial times injective maps. For each fixed \(c\) the c-class \(\chi^2\) contribution tends to \(q^{-c^2-2cs}/\prod_{j=1}^c(1-q^{-j})\). Uniform class-count and multiplier bounds make the full tail negligible. Rank of a t-step sum ≤t yields TV lower obstruction, and \(\chi^2\to0\) above \(n\) yields the upper bound. The included check.py exactly verifies generators, Fourier characters, and convolution/Plancherel for GF(2), GF(3), GF(4), GF(5) small dimensions. Asymptotic proof is analytical, not inferred from finite tests.
